stem: How were former Confederate leaders treated under the Radical Reconstruction plan?

options.label: A
options.text: They were denied citizenship because it was believed they had started the war.

options.label: B
options.text: They were required to enlist in the U.S. Army for two years.

options.label: C
options.text: They were denied the ability to obtain political positions.

options.label: D
options.text: They were allowed to obtain federal loans to help restore the cotton industry.
